title: Hyponormal block Toeplitz operators with finite rank self-commutators
summary: In this paper, we identify a large class of hyponormal block Toeplitz operators whose self-commutators are of finite rank. \ Recall that an operator $T_\varphi$ is hyponormal and $[T_\varphi^{*}, T_\varphi]$ is a finite rank operator if and only if there exists a finite Blaschke product $b$ in $\mathcal{E}(\varphi)$, where $$ \mathcal{E}(\varphi) := \{k \in H^\infty(\mathbb{T}): \left\|k\right\|_\infty \le 1 \textrm{ and } \varphi-k\cdot \bar{\varphi} \in H^\infty(\mathbb{T})\}. $$ An analogous set $\mathcal{E}(Φ)$ can be defined for a matrix-valued symbol $Φ$. \ In the block Toeplitz…
